request.questionText: Make sure you're familiar with the concept of an "object" from our course packet, which is essential to coding in R. Then consider the following block of R code. objectA = 10objectB = 2*objectA + 10objectC = objectB/6 Which of the following statements about this code block is accurate? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: If we were to run this block of code, one result will be that objectB should now store the value 30.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If we were to run this block of code, one result will be that objectC should now store the value 10.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The statement "objectC = objectB/6" is not correct, because the left-hand side and the right-hand side of the equals sign are not actually equal to each other.

choices.label: D
choices.text: This block of code illustrates the assignment of values to objects using R's assignment operator (=).

choices.label: E
choices.text: This code block will run just fine if you type it directly into the console. But the best practice here would be to type the commands into a script instead, and then run those commands from the script.
